Source: https://foozlecc.itch.io/trap-pack
License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0)
Original commission: David / Chroma Dave
Distributor: Foozle

## Prepared sheets

| File | Frame size | Suggested stage | Use |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `arrow_trap.png` | 32x32 | 2-3 | Wall warning, then one arrow |
| `fire.png` | 32x64 | 3-4 | Short floor flame burst |
| `ceiling_spikes.png` | 64x64 | 3-4 | Shadow warning, then falling spikes |
| `saw.png` | 64x64 | 4 | Fixed patrol rail hazard |
| `toxic.png` | 64x64 | 4 | Slow poison cloud burst |

## Game rules

- No traps in Stage 1.
- Traps must show a warning for at least 0.7 seconds.
- A normal hit should remove 0.5 heart.
- Never place a trap on a sealed-room entrance.
- Keep one safe landing tile beside every trap.
- Stage 2 may use one arrow trap per room.
- Stage 3 may use fire or ceiling spikes.
- Stage 4 may mix two trap types per room.
